== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Death Star: Detention Block Corridor]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ds-death-star-detention-block-corridor/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ds_DEATH_STAR_DETENTION_BLOCK_CORRIDOR.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>98eb04578e32f4f266c2f9b1916f8224607491810641ff3f628b6e8d0cb4d004</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
